verdict.rationale: Svelte and SvelteKit are fully open-source (MIT) and run entirely via local tooling (npx sv create, npm install/run dev) with no vendor-hosted service dependency, and SvelteKit explicitly supports static site generation/adapter-static so output can be self-hosted anywhere. This is inherent to the product's nature as a compiler/framework rather than a SaaS.  missing for 10: explicit self-hosting/deployment guides beyond adapter-static mention, and independent corroboration of large-scale self-hosted deployments.
